title: topia
text: All paradises, all utopias are designed by who is not there, by the people who are not allowed in.
and it is marvelous in our eyes.

If our kingdom-likeness is the sum of the dot products of ourselves and our relationships in n-dimensional space, then how radical must our love and empathy be in order to steward the Kingdom of God on earth? Just as Jesus modeled, we must - even as vectors seemingly defined by the affine coordinate system of the broken institutions that surround us - answer God's invitation and journey bravely into dimensions we never knew existed, running this race with other-wordly grace and humility, until we receive the unfading crown of glory.
